Lite runs on Android or iOS in edge-times on an everyday phone; Core is Android-only and requires a dedicated, factory-reset device. Official docs describe shared Base Benchmark and Staked Compute pools; these are network-wide amounts, not a provider payout. Device score, matching, uptime, stake, costs, liquidity, and exit fees affect realizable value. GamCryp currently marks Acurast ROI not measurable because per-provider earnings and complete cost/exit assumptions are not verified. Review the evidence page and official sources below.
